security.title: Security
security.description: Not a service, but a check of the configuration.
security.mismatch: Does not match the stored data
security.mismatchHint: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not the key the stored data is encrypted with, or a key rotation has not finished. Stored data may then fail to decrypt.

session.title: Automatic logout
session.description: Logs the web interface out after a period without input. Applies to all users, not to the desktop client.
session.idleTimeoutHint: 0 = never. Never logs out during a recording or while its transcription is running.
